biotools.summary: srahunter is a Python tool designed to simplify data and metadata acquisition from the NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA). It leverages SRA Toolkit and Entrez Direct to provide automated downloading, data management, and metadata integration for efficient SRA data access.
